name: API Test Lab Free
free_limit: 100 manual API tests per month for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE and PATCH; last 10 requests in history. Includes one 30-second load-test trial with up to five workers.
watch_out: Free tier has no saved requests, scheduled testing, API/CI integration, traffic monitoring or AI analysis. Tests stop at the monthly allowance until reset or upgrade; the single load-test trial is not recurring. Commercial-use permission not explicitly confirmed.
